newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banacci cuts Kimberly-Clark de Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Banacci cuts Kimberly-Clark de Mexico.

text.p: The brokerage arm of Mexican financial group Banamex-Accival (Banacci) downgraded consumer products group Kimberly-Clark de Mexico SA de CV to neutral from buy because of the outlook for prices and the low margins seen in the first quarter.
"Growth of Kimberly will be slower than we first thought, and for that reason we have revised our recommendations down," analysts Gonzalo Fernandez and Antonio Guadarrama said in a report.
The analysts said they considered that Kimberly-Clark de Mexico share price could be at 33 pesos per share by the year end.
